description: This file defines the 'metadata' package for gRPC in Go, including data structures and functions for handling gRPC metadata, such as creating, copying, appending, and retrieving metadata in contexts.

methods.name: DecodeKeyValue
methods.description: Returns the key and value as provided; deprecated in favor of using key and value directly.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new MD map from a string-to-string map, converting keys to lowercase.

methods.name: Pairs
methods.description: Creates an MD map from pairs of strings, panics if the number of strings is odd.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the number of keys in the MD map.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the MD map.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the values for a given key, case-insensitive.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the values for a given key, replacing existing values.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends values to a key without overwriting existing values.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a key and its values from the MD map.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Merges multiple MD maps into one.

methods.name: NewIncomingContext
methods.description: Creates a new context with incoming MD attached.

methods.name: NewOutgoingContext
methods.description: Creates a new context with outgoing MD attached.

methods.name: AppendToOutgoingContext
methods.description: Returns a new context with additional key-value pairs merged into outgoing MD.

methods.name: ValueFromIncomingContext
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a specific key from incoming MD, case-insensitive.
